blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Model building (model banana) ka kirdaar aur ahmiyat, aur asal zindagi mein iske istemal, samajh sakenge.
Asal zindagi ke masail ke liye bunyadi statistical models (shumariyati model) bana sakenge aur unki performance (kitna sahi chalte hain) jaanch sakenge.
Data science mein experimental design (tajurbe ka khaka) samajh aur samjha sakenge.
Data visualization (data ko chart ya tasveer se dikhana) ki qismein, istemal aur tareeqe bata sakenge.
Descriptive statistics (data ka khulasa batane wale adad) ke zariye data dikhane ke fawaid samajh sakenge.
Visualization software, jaise MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python, Tableau ya Matplotlib, se data visualization bana aur samjha sakenge.

blocks.text: Model building ka matlab hai kisi complex (uljhe hue) masle ki ek saada shakal (simplified representation) banana. Is mein sirf aham hisson (key elements) par tawajjo di jati hai. Is se asal zindagi ke masail ko samajhna, un ka jaiza lena (analyze karna) aur unhein hal karna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Model kya chhor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Model ghair zaroori tafseel (unnecessary details) chhor deta hai, ta ke tawajjo masle ke sab se aham hisson par rahe.

items: Model building: complex masle ki saada shakal banana jis mein sirf aham hisse rakhe jate hain.
